text: 就是忽然懂了“少壮不努力，中年继续学习”“父母不努力、娃们要多努力” ！
en: It was only that I suddenly understood 'if you don't strive when young, you keep learning in middle age' and 'if parents don't strive, the children must strive all the more'!

text: 人到中年，重新获得了前所未有的动力，为了自己的下半生，为了娃们的起点，为了父母大人们的幸福晚年，你发现你必须往前努力，学习，突破自己！
en: When you reach middle age, you regain an unprecedented drive. For the sake of your own latter half of life, for the starting point of your children, for the happy later years of your parents, you find that you must press forward, study, and break through yourself!

text: 你没法逃避，因为逃避意味着你自己对自己不满意，对娃感到愧疚，对老人感到无能为力，这样子的人生你是没法开怀的。
en: You cannot escape, because escaping means you are dissatisfied with yourself, feel guilty towards your children, and feel helpless towards the elderly. A life like this, you cannot live with an open heart.

text: 所以努力了，拼搏了，甚至是随波逐流的获得一份稳定的生活银两，确实会让生活看似安稳，至少像陈奕迅的《稳稳的幸福》，哪怕你偶尔也会想，为啥必须是我负重前行，为啥我不能有躺平摆烂的人生…
en: So, having striven and fought, even drifting with the current to gain a stable livelihood, does make life seem settled, at least like Eason Chan's 'Stable Happiness', even though, occasionally, you still think: why must it be me who bears the heavy burden forward, why can't I have a life of lying flat and giving up...

text: ..你如今已老年的父母曾经也是中年，为养育你和他们的父母大人尽了他们最大的努力！
en: ..Your parents, now elderly, were once middle-aged too, and did their utmost to raise you and their own parents!

text: 如今，这个传承到了你这一代，就必须承担起为人子、为人父的责任！
en: Now, this inheritance has passed to your generation, and you must take up the responsibility of being a son and a father!

text: 毕竟，不去承担责任，懦弱的活着会更加痛苦，生活会让你体会儿更多艰苦辛酸，甚至还有对你尊严的挑战！
en: After all, not taking responsibility and living cowardly will be even more painful. Life will let you experience even more hardship and bitterness, even challenges to your dignity!

text: 既如此，强大起来，没什么犹豫，冲上去，主宰它！
en: Since it is so, grow strong, hesitate no more, charge forward, and master it!

text: 准备出门前刷到这个话题。
en: Scrolled past this topic just before getting ready to go out.

text: 坐下来答一波。
en: Sat down to answer a round.

text: 夫妻二人带着一个女儿，住在城郊三层小屋。
en: A couple with one daughter, living in a three-storey small house in the suburbs.

text: 休息的时候里帮老婆装饰装饰花园，割割草，水电，木工啥都会点。
en: On rest days he helps his wife tidy up the garden, mow the lawn, and knows a bit of plumbing, electrical work and carpentry.

text: 工作起来还跟30岁一样，因为机会还在眼前，现状还不甚满意。
en: He still works as if he were 30, because opportunities are still before him and he is not quite satisfied with the status quo.

text: 经常对下属发火，修养不够。
en: He often loses his temper with subordinates; his self-cultivation is lacking.

text: 身体还行，前两年跑步过度，伤了关节，现在最爱冥想。
en: His health is all right. Two years ago he ran too much and injured his joints; now his favourite thing is meditation.

text: 为了小孩上学，买了学区房，借了几十万外债，压力不大。
en: For the child's schooling, he bought a school-district flat, borrowed several hundred thousand in external debt, and the pressure is not great.

text: 差不多该出门了…
en: About time to head out...

text: 一地鸡毛
en: a mess of trivialities

text: 这个问题适合我，因为最近一直在面临这个问题。
en: This question suits me, because I have been facing this issue recently.

text: 1. 人到中年了，人生过半了，开始发现时间过的太快了。
en: 1. Having reached middle age, with life more than half over, I begin to realise time passes too quickly.

text: 2. 身体健康出现了各种问题，精力大不如以前。
en: 2. Various problems have appeared in physical health, and energy is far less than before.

text: 3. 很可能会因为工作生活的不如意而感觉到失落，甚至抑郁。
en: 3. One is very likely to feel lost, even depressed, because of dissatisfaction with work and life.

text: 4. 如果遇到生活的低谷，很可能会不断质疑自己。
en: 4. If you encounter a low point in life, you are very likely to keep questioning yourself.

text: 面对当前的经济形势，现在有许多中年人都生活在焦虑中，这种焦虑就是来自于自己收入的不稳定。
en: Facing the current economic situation, many middle-aged people now live in anxiety, and this anxiety comes from the instability of their own income.

text: 回答这个粉丝的问题，一个40岁左右的中年人，如何能获得一份稳定的收入？
en: Answering this fan's question: how can a middle-aged person of around 40 obtain a stable income?

text: 问题其实很简单，只要做好以下几方面就完全可以。
en: The question is actually quite simple; as long as you do well in the following aspects, it is entirely possible.

text: 首先就是有投资性收入，譬如股权，基金，股票，商铺，房产等，这些都是可以形成管道收入的途径。
en: First is to have investment income, such as equity, funds, stocks, shops, property and so on, all of which are channels that can form pipeline income.

text: 对于一个中年人来说，面对不确定的生存环境，光有危机感肯定是不行，要未雨绸缪，给自己留好后路，这样日子就会过得相对安稳一些。
en: For a middle-aged person, facing an uncertain living environment, having only a sense of crisis certainly will not do. You must plan ahead and leave yourself a way out, so that life will be relatively settled.

text: 但社会上往往许多人不注重这方面，不仅仅是不留后路，反而是提前消费，那么，一旦遭遇到经济形势转变，就会导致自己措手不及，今年就是很好的证明。
en: But in society many people do not pay attention to this aspect. Not only do they fail to leave a way out, they instead consume in advance. Then, once they encounter an economic turn, it leaves them unprepared, and this year is good proof.

text: 所以说，一个40岁的中年人，如何能获得一份稳定性收入？
en: Therefore, how can a 40-year-old middle-aged person obtain a stable income?

text: 首先就是有投资性收入，俗话说就是躺赚。
en: First is to have investment income, which, as the saying goes, is earning while lying flat.

text: 其次是能力和经验，这是一个人一生取之不尽用之不竭的财富。
en: Next are ability and experience, which are wealth that can never be exhausted in a person's lifetime.

text: 社会上的一些40岁左右的中年人，为什么自己会焦虑不安？
en: Why do some middle-aged people of around 40 in society feel anxious and unsettled?

text: 就是没有底气，这种所谓的底气，就是能力和经验。
en: It is simply a lack of confidence; this so-called confidence is ability and experience.

text: 面对当前的经济形势，许多人面临失业的风险，那他为什么会失业呢？
en: Facing the current economic situation, many people face the risk of unemployment, so why would he become unemployed?

text: 别人为什么依然在拿着高工资，过着悠哉的生活？
en: Why do others still draw high salaries and live a leisurely life?

text: 差距显而易见，就是能力和经验。
en: The gap is obvious; it is ability and experience.

text: 所以，对于一个40岁左右的中年人来说，如果想获得一份稳定的收入，那肯定是先提升个人能力，这是关键中的关键。
en: Therefore, for a middle-aged person of around 40, if he wants to obtain a stable income, he must first improve his personal ability, and this is the key of keys.

text: 现在很多中年人都在想自己能有稳定的收入，能过上更好的生活，那首先就应该考虑的是个人能力的提升，其他没有什么捷径。
en: Now many middle-aged people are thinking about having a stable income and living a better life; then the first thing to consider should be the improvement of personal ability. There is no other shortcut.

text: 最后就是自己给自己打工，选择创业或者做一点力所能及的小生意。
en: Finally, it is to work for yourself, choosing to start a business or do a small trade within your ability.

text: 当前许多人的认知，都认为创业风险大，上班比较稳妥，其实打工更是高风险。
en: Many people's current understanding holds that starting a business is risky and having a job is relatively safe; in fact, working for others is the higher risk.

text: 因为你把命运交在别人手里掌握着，那自然会心里没底，并且活得太累，活得整天心惊胆颤。
en: Because you place your fate in someone else's hands, naturally you feel insecure, and live too wearily, living in constant fear and trepidation all day long.

text: 自己给自己打工，这样活得就会有底气，因为市场一直在，有市场就会有事业可做，就会有挣钱的途径。
en: Working for yourself, you will then live with confidence, because the market is always there; where there is a market, there is a career to be made and a way to earn money.

text: 如果说创业高风险，那就把步子迈得稳一点，自己能掌控好，能把握住，这样就相对稳妥。
en: If you say starting a business is high risk, then take steadier steps that you can control and grasp, and this way it is relatively safe.

text: 所以，一个中年人，如果能自己给自己打工，这样也能获得稳定的收入，只是多少而已。
en: Therefore, a middle-aged person, if he can work for himself, can also obtain a stable income this way, it is only a matter of how much.

text: 综上所述，对于一个40岁左右的中年人，要想获得稳定的收入，做好上面任何一点都可以。
en: In summary, for a middle-aged person of around 40 who wishes to obtain a stable income, doing well in any one of the above points will do.

text: 如果这些方面都不具备，那一定是活得太累，太紧张，没有一丝安全感。
en: If you possess none of these aspects, then you must be living too wearily, too tense, without the slightest sense of security.

text: 早知道…
en: If only I had known...

text: 就…
en: then...

text: 还有什么能比”原以为的幸福全职宝妈生活“被打脸，离婚，独自带娃，没有学历，又与社会脱节好几年，更惨的吗？
en: What could be more miserable than having the 'happily imagined full-time stay-at-home mum life' slapped in the face, divorce, raising a child alone, no educational qualifications, and being out of touch with society for several years?

text: 最扎心的回答一定是：今年过半了，我还在喝西北风，我的上面那个闺蜜先暴富了！
en: The most heart-piercing answer must be: the year is already more than half over, and I am still going hungry, while the close friend above me got rich first!

text: 这段时间，我们就被闺蜜华华狠狠扎了心。
en: During this period, we had our hearts severely pierced by our close friend Huahua.

text: 她结婚后很快就怀孕了，由于她原本就是一普通上班族，工资也不高，孕后期就主动辞去了工作，在家养胎，生产，带娃...
en: She became pregnant soon after marrying. Since she was originally just an ordinary office worker with a not-so-high salary, in the later stage of pregnancy she voluntarily resigned, staying home to nurture the baby, give birth, and raise the child...

text: 好不容易把孩子带到上幼儿园了，时间也多了起来，却发现老公，早就背着自己出轨了。
en: Having finally brought the child to kindergarten age and gained more free time, she discovered that her husband had long ago cheated on her behind her back.

text: 她没哭没闹，本也没什么财产可分，唯一一套房子，是男方婚前贷款买的，她只有一个要求：孩子是自己十月怀胎生下的，也是自己一手带大，必须归自己。
en: She neither cried nor made a scene. There was in truth little property to divide; the only flat was bought by the man with a loan before marriage. She had only one demand: the child she bore after ten months of pregnancy and raised single-handedly must belong to her.

text: 只简单的收拾了母女二的衣物，便离开了那个男人，那个家。
en: She simply packed the clothing of mother and daughter, then left that man and that home.

text: 清醒得有点让人心疼.
en: She was so clear-headed it was almost heart-breaking.

text: 她似乎刻意断开了与原来朋友的联系，再见她已是一年多以后。
en: She seemed deliberately to cut off contact with her old friends; when we saw her again it was already over a year later.

text: 谁知一见面，华华不仅请一年没见的大家吃很贵的日料，见面时还开上了新买的车，甚至“不小心”透露刚给孩子报名一对一外教班，更是全款为母女二人买了一套116平的房子。
en: Who would have thought that upon meeting, Huahua not only treated everyone she hadn't seen for a year to very expensive Japanese cuisine, but also arrived driving a newly bought car, and even 'accidentally' let slip that she had just enrolled her child in a one-to-one foreign tutor class, and had even bought a 116-square-metre flat for mother and daughter in full cash.

text: 虽然我们这里是四五线城市。
en: Although we are in a fourth- or fifth-tier city here.

text: 我们都惊讶她变化如此之大，开她玩笑说是不是傍上大款了？
en: We were all astonished at how much she had changed, and joked with her, asking whether she had hooked a rich man.

text: 没想到华华说：哎呀，经历过一次失败的感情，我终于明白，谁也不能为你撑起一片天，女人必须要经济独立才可以。
en: Unexpectedly Huahua said: 'Oh, having experienced a failed relationship once, I finally understand that no one can hold up the sky for you. A woman must be financially independent.'

text: 离婚后我就把孩子交给了孩子的姥姥暂时照顾。
en: After the divorce I left the child in the temporary care of the child's maternal grandmother.

text: 到藏秘缘藏秘香泥总部去考察学习，回来之后找我妈借了钱开了现在这的家藏秘缘健康生活馆。
en: She went to the headquarters of Cangmi Yuan Cangmi Xiangni to investigate and learn, and after returning borrowed money from my mother to open the current Cangmi Yuan Health Life Centre.

text: 还真别说，目前各行各业实体店都举步维艰，但是健康养生行业却是不受网络冲击，因为藏秘的效果比较好，都是客人带客人，做起来真是太简单了。
en: Truth be told, physical shops in all trades are struggling at present, but the health and wellness industry is unaffected by the internet's impact, because Cangmi's effect is rather good, and it is all customers bringing customers, so it is really too simple to run.

text: 疫情影响，经济不好，可以少买衣服，可以少下馆子，但是很多人颈椎病的，腰酸背痛，长斑长痘，乳腺问题，妇科问题的，肠胃问题...都知道去医院也没什么好方法，吃药也很贵。
en: With the pandemic's impact and a weak economy, one can buy fewer clothes and eat out less, but many people with cervical spine problems, sore waists and aching backs, spots and acne, breast issues, gynaecological problems, and stomach and intestine problems all know that hospitals have no good remedies, and medicine is also expensive.

text: 我做这个藏秘项目，听起来好像也有点小贵，但是效果是真的好，还不用吃药不用打针，安全又无副作用。
en: The Cangmi project I do sounds perhaps a little pricey, but the effect is genuinely good, and it requires no medicine and no injections, safe and without side effects.

text: 通常是一个客人感觉好了之后，就不自觉地分享给身边的朋友，同事，带家人一起来。
en: Usually, after one customer feels better, they involuntarily share with the friends and colleagues around them, bringing family along.

text: 真别说，以前有人和我说健康行业，我也不相信，现在才明白，这个行业利润不是一般的大，最主要的是客人得到实实在在的健康，他们满意，我顺便也收获财富（她笑颜如花），不然一年的时间，我干啥能全款买上房？
en: To tell the truth, when someone told me about the health industry before, I didn't believe it either. Only now do I understand that this industry's profits are extraordinarily large. Most importantly, the customers gain real, tangible health; they are satisfied, and I incidentally gain wealth too (she smiled like a flower). Otherwise, in just one year, what could I have done to buy a flat in full cash?

text: 惊讶之余，仔细打量了一下华华。
en: Amid the surprise, I looked Huahua over carefully.

text: 她确实和上以前不一样了，妆容精致，穿着名牌，谈吐间特别自信。
en: She truly was different from before: exquisite make-up, wearing brand names, and especially confident in her speech.

text: 当年那个甚至可以说有点邋遢的宝妈，俨然成了一个成功老板娘，魅力四射。
en: That stay-at-home mum who could even be called somewhat slovenly back then had evidently become a successful shop proprietress, radiant with charm.

text: 在我们的追问下，华华透露出了一些内幕：原来她做的这个藏秘缘项目，走的是传统加盟模式，却不收任何的加盟费，只需要进一定量的货，公司总部安排老师下店，手把手扶持。
en: Under our persistent questioning, Huahua revealed some inside information: it turns out the Cangmi Yuan project she does follows the traditional franchise model yet charges no franchise fee whatsoever; you only need to stock a certain amount of goods, and the company headquarters arranges for teachers to go to the shop and support you hands-on.

text: 她第一个月就收回了成本，还有盈利10000多元，之后一个月比一个月生意更好。
en: In her first month she already recovered her costs and made a profit of over 10,000 yuan; after that, business was better month by month.

text: 这家公司已经做了15年的时间了（优胜劣汰是自然规律），全国各地都有一些加盟店，各方面都非常的成熟和人性化。
en: This company has been operating for 15 years (survival of the fittest is a natural law), with franchise shops dotted around the country; in every respect it is very mature and humane.

text: 不管你在哪个城市，原来是做什么行业的，人家包教包会，专业老师直接下店扶持。
en: Regardless of which city you are in or what industry you were originally in, they guarantee to teach you until you master it, with professional teachers going directly to the shop to support you.

text: 不额外收任何费用。
en: They charge no additional fees.

text: 这家公司是之所以做得这么成功就在于；公司首先保证加盟商先赚到钱，且门槛低，几万块店就能开起来，当月回本盈利。
en: The reason this company has succeeded so well is this: the company first ensures franchisees earn money first, and the threshold is low, a shop can be opened for tens of thousands of yuan and recoup costs and turn a profit within the same month.

text: 半年后月利润可达10W+.
en: After half a year, monthly profit can reach 100k+.

text: 怪不得华华像变了个人似的，原来是钱给她的底气。
en: No wonder Huahua seems like a changed person, it turns out money gave her that confidence.

text: 无性无爱的这一年，她全款买了房，最狠的报复方式就是：你一定要过得比ta好！
en: In this year without sex or love, she bought a flat in full cash. The fiercest form of revenge is: you absolutely must live better than them!
